channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Say cheese: Witnesses record ICE’s brutality
item.description: A retired pastor argues that cellphone videos exposing ICE violence and Trump’s cruelty reveal a growing threat to minorities, democracy and the planet — and a moral duty to resist.

item.title: Three wishes for the telehealth genie
item.description: A new report says telehealth is cost-effective and here to stay — but North Carolina flunks key reforms. John Hood outlines three “wishes” to expand access and tap new federal funding.

item.title: The health care election
item.description: With health care costs now voters’ top concern, lapsing ACA subsidies, Medicaid cuts and budget gridlock are driving up premiums and straining care — and could dominate this November’s campaigns.

item.title: We need permitting reform
item.description: A climate advocate links recent extreme weather to global warming and argues that bipartisan permitting reform is needed to speed clean energy, storage and transmission projects.

item.title: Don’t give your vote away
item.description: A Wilson County resident urges voters not to sit out the 2026 elections, citing low turnout, key voting dates, a state ballot lookup site and options for early, mail-in voting to help every voice be heard.

item.title: Area Calendar, Feb. 5-6, 2026
item.description: Area sports schedule for Feb. 5-6 featuring high school boys, girls and JV basketball matchups plus Barton men’s volleyball and baseball games.

item.title: Roster changes in your life will happen, so be ready
item.description: Former Duke goalkeeper E.J. Proctor reflects on how life’s “rosters” change, why shrinking social circles is normal, and how a few deep, value-aligned friendships can matter more than a crowd.

item.title: Farris & Thomas Law Student-Athlete of the Week: Cameron Moore, Greenfield School
item.description: Greenfield School sophomore Cameron Moore earns Farris & Thomas Law Student-Athlete of the Week after back-to-back 13-point games, standout defense, strong academics and community service.

item.title: Morgan named first Warbirds manager as 2026 Wilson staff announced
item.description: Eddy Morgan, a longtime NCAA Division III coach, has been named first manager of the Wilson Warbirds, who announced their inaugural 2026 staff ahead of their April 14 opener.

item.title: Remembering Charlie's kind words, warm smile and love for Wilson
item.description: A tribute to Charles H. “Charlie” Bedgood IV, a 41-year-old Wilson leader whose family legacy, civic service and kindness left a deep mark on his hometown and all who knew him.
